description: Use this when a customer wants an insurance quote and you need the coverage Menlo can quote and where, for example builders risk insurance for a home renovation, vacant home insurance, a difference-in-conditions (DIC) policy alongside the California FAIR Plan, or event insurance for a wedding. Returns each published quote form's formId, label, states served, website quote link and how requests are processed. Availability does not guarantee eligibility or a carrier quote. Do not use for claims or changes to an existing policy.
name: list_products
title: Find Menlo insurance products
